findings.claim: Q1 2026 Gold 訂閱用戶年增 36% 至創高 430 萬，訂閱營收年增 57% 至 8,500 萬美元，加密交易營收年減 47%
findings.source: Nasdaq: Robinhood Gold Hits Record Subscribers

findings.claim: Robinhood 預測市場原透過第三方交易所（主要 Kalshi）配送，正轉向自有交易所
findings.source: TIKR: Robinhood has lost 52% from its highs
findings.excerpt: Prediction markets became Robinhood’s fastest-growing revenue segment in 2025. The company traded 8.8 billion event contracts in Q1 2026 alone, a record. Until now, Robinhood routed those contracts through third-party exchanges, primarily Kalshi, absorbing distribution costs without capturing exchange-level economics.
